title: VARCHAR Data Type
description: Learn how to use the VARCHAR data type to store variable-length, non-Unicode string data.

data.text: The VARCHAR data type stores variable-length, non-Unicode string data. Use VARCHAR when the data length varies from row to row.

data.title: VARCHAR Syntax
data.content: Defines a VARCHAR column with a specified length.

data.title: VARCHAR(max) Syntax
data.content: Defines a VARCHAR column with maximum storage of 2 GB.

data.text: n defines the string length from 1 to 8,000. If not specified, the default is 1. The storage size is the actual length of the data plus 2 bytes.

data.title: Create VARCHAR Column
data.content: Creates a table with a VARCHAR column and demonstrates insertion.

data.title: VARCHAR Key Points
points: VARCHAR stores variable-length, non-Unicode string data.
Length ranges from 1 to 8,000 characters; use VARCHAR(max) for up to 2 GB.
Storage size is actual length plus 2 bytes.
Use VARCHAR when data lengths vary across rows.
